desc:
🗣️ Welcome to Steal A Rainbow Friend!

👍 Like the game and join the group
🥚 Next Guaranteed Mythic Rainbow Friend Drops at: 1,000 LIKES

How to Play:
🌈 Buy  Rainbow Friend
🥷 Sneak in and steal Rainbow Friends from other players
💸 Generate coins from your Rainbow Friends
🌟 Rebirth for better chances at rarer Rainbow Friends
😈 Use troll gear to prank and distract others!

💻 Supports Desktop, Mobile and Tablet players
